verdict.rationale: Windmill's workflows-as-code engine supports loops with built-in parallelism and checkpointing, so many items can be processed in one run. Its Compare & Deploy page can also deploy multiple AI-edited items together. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated bulk-operation feature, such as a for-each loop over item lists or bulk-selecting items to act on. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch or for-each-over-items documentation, bulk actions on workspace items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: using familiar language constructs like functions, conditionals, and loops, while Windmill handles checkpointing, parallelism, and fault tolerance
it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy
